thread:
jess: Heads up — I pushed a PR to refresh the quickstart (hello-world, auth flow, first deploy). Main changes: SDK v5 snippets, simplified env var steps, and a shorter curl example. Need 1) link fix for the CLI section, 2) a tiny wording tweak for the token guidance, and 3) an extra note about private deployment creds. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
laura: on it. which file has the CLI link?
jess: docs/quickstart/hello-node.md — the link points to the old cli v2 page. should go to /cli/usage (SDK v5).
ben: can you paste the curl example that changed? quick glance first.
jess: sure:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-base-1","input":"hello"}'
```
jess: I replaced REDWOOD_API_KEY with instructions to export REDWOOD_API_KEY from the env examples and added a note about using a service token for CI.
sam: thumbs up for the service token note. can we be explicit about scopes? e.g., `scopes: generate, embeddings`
mike: +1. also, minor nit: change "first deploy" section to mention `deploy-bot` will announce staging URL, and add a step to check console logs for 403s.
laura: fixing CLI link and the deploy-bot note now.
doc-bot: lint-check results: 3 warnings in hello-node.md — markdown link style, trailing whitespace, and a codeblock language tag missing.
laura: I'll fix lint ones. ben, mike — want to review wording for token scopes?
ben: I can review in ~30m.
mike: I can do a pass too.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy for PR #842 started (job id 9921). I will post the URL when ready.
jess: thanks. also noticed the SDK snippet for JS still uses callbacks in one spot. I converted to async/await — feel free to revert if it breaks the examples.
ben: prefer async/await. clearer for new devs.
sam: small thought — add a one-line migration note at top: "If you're migrating from SDK v4, see migration guide" and link to /docs/migration/v4-to-v5.
jess: added that in a new commit.
laura: pushed fixes: CLI link -> /cli/usage, token wording tweak, removed trailing whitespace, added ```js tag on the snippet.
doc-bot: lint-check results: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
ben: reviewing now. found one contextual issue in the env section where `REDWOOD_API_KEY` is shown as optional — should be required for first deploy.
mike: good catch. laura, can you update to say "required for initial deploy"?
laura: updated. also added the note about checking console logs for 403s.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy complete: https://staging.redwood-inference.io/pr-842 — smoke tests passed (tokened endpoints check).
jess: throwing a final review request: @ben @mike — if no objections, I'll merge and backport a tiny link fix to the starter-app repo. :shipit:
ben: LGTM
mike: LGTM 
jess: merging in 10. thanks all :tada:
laura: can someone follow up to add the migration note to the hello-python quickstart too? I can do it but low bandwidth this week.
sam: I'll add the python note tomorrow morning.
ben: noted for release notes — add an item: "Quickstart refresh: updated SDK v5 snippets, CLI link, token guidance"
jess: added to release-notes draft.
laura: solid. closing thread once merged.
